hook.why: Spin the bottle — a harmless party game — turns instantly into horror comedy when the loser screams. The gap between the casual setup and the dramatic reaction makes you wait to find out what the forfeit is.

scenes.action: A girl in a white jumpsuit spins a green bottle. It points at the boy in yellow, who screams and cries dramatically.
scenes.camera: Wide looking down on the circle, then quick cut to a low-angle close-up
scenes.visual: Three Roblox characters around a green bottle in an office-like room.

scenes.action: The yellow character runs to the "Doctors Only" door, knocks frantically, and panics when Dr. Harlow opens it.
scenes.camera: Medium from behind, switching to over-the-shoulder close-up
scenes.visual: Hallway door signed "Restricted Access / Doctors Only"; antlered Dr. Harlow appears.

scenes.action: Back in the room the girl spins again. It lands on her; she collapses face-down.
scenes.camera: Medium eye-level, then slight high angle as she drops
scenes.visual: The bottle glowing as it spins, settling toward the centre girl.

scenes.action: The bottle lands on the boy in pink, who cycles through angry and distressed meme faces.
scenes.visual: Pink character seated, face morphing in exaggerated reactions.

scenes.action: The pink character walks to the door and knocks. Dr. Harlow opens it with a monstrous open jaw, scaring him backward.
scenes.camera: Medium from behind, cutting to a close front view of Harlow
scenes.visual: Metal door opening onto Dr. Harlow transformed, sharp teeth bared.

scenes.action: The pink character flexes, turns, returns to Dr. Harlow and gives him a friendly handshake.
scenes.camera: Medium moving shot down the hallway, then a side two-shot at the doorway
scenes.visual: Hospital corridor with vending machines; the two shaking hands.

scenes.action: The bottle is spun again and releases green gas. All three characters react in agony and pass out.
scenes.camera: Medium wide of the room, quick cuts between distressed faces
scenes.visual: Green smoke pouring from the tipped bottle; characters down on the floor.

scenes.action: Dr. Harlow walks the corridor, spots a green recycling bin, and climbs inside to hide.
scenes.camera: Medium tracking shot, locking onto the bin
scenes.visual: Corner of the hallway with a green recycling bin.

scenes.action: The girl crawls out and hits the red door buzzer. Dr. Harlow grabs and body-slams her, throwing her under a hospital bed where red eyes glow in the dark.
scenes.camera: Low-angle wide tracking her crawl, fast medium cut to the struggle, ending on a static wide
scenes.visual: Sterile medical room; glowing red eyes beneath the hospital bed.
